name: NGC 7009 · 直焦视野
note: DSS2-red optical photographic counts, BUNIT absent. Morphology only: 5-pixel opening approximates diffuse/compact separation; global P25 floor, P99.7 diffuse and P99.8 compact scaling, illustrative squared diffuse contrast, 2x sampling. Ha scale 2e-05 W/m²/sr and OIII ratio 2.0 are ASSUMED. M42 OIII is additionally centrally weighted (sigma 0.28 deg); Horsehead OIII is an illustrative weak copy; NGC7009 Ha/OIII are centrally restricted by an assumed sigma 0.009 deg Gaussian. Hipparcos V<9 compact footprints (radius 3.5 original pixels) are replaced with catalogue point sources; positions ICRS epoch J1991.25, no proper motion. Residual faint plate stars and catalogue stars use an ASSUMED 6000K continuum; V=0 flux is assumed 2e-8 W/m² across 300–1100nm. Plate saturation, diffraction spikes, diffuse halos and residual noise may remain; none is a simulated tube response. No absolute calibration or independent spectral recovery. Original measured MUSE/CDS scenes remain separately available.
processing: All brightness/line decomposition is an engineering morphology hypothesis.
No new simulated noise or physical tube halo is baked into templates.
TAN coordinates, row0 south, columns increase west.
Uint16 linear quantization; absolute error <= half of each stored scale.
